int_name: W HUNTING PARK AVE & RISING SUN AVE

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection adjacent to residential row housing with basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps. However, the environment is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement quality, and a long, unprotected crossing distance across multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in the asphalt within the crossing area create trip hazards and may affect vehicle braking performance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Apply new, high-visibility thermoplastic crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area mid-street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk across a wide four-lane roadway, but lacks a sidewalk on the right side. While overhead traffic signals are present, there are no visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands, creating a high-exposure environment for crossing.

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk network is absent on the right side of the road, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces after crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway beyond the crosswalk

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island for protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main road

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the right side of the road to ensure a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The image shows a wide intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk but lacks signalization or a pedestrian refuge. While a sidewalk exists on the right side near commercial properties, the left side appears to lack paved pedestrian infrastructure, forcing people onto unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: Lack of a paved sidewalk on the left side of the road forces pedestrians to walk on the grass or shoulder.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any signalization or refuge, exposing pedestrians to traffic for the entire width of the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground crossing the main road

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the crosswalk to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver awareness at the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and a median refuge. A large transit bus is currently obstructing sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic, creating a significant safety hazard.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A SEPTA bus is positioned in a way that blocks the view of pedestrians for drivers and vice versa at the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, occupying the travel lane adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: While vehicle signals are present, no dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible to guide safe crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.
